lighting.intent: Commercial axis-exploded valve lighting: expose the fixed ball-center datum, readable moved body shell, X-axis part stacks, and small hardware arrays with broad softbox reflections.

lights.name: wide_front_key
lights.role: large neutral key softbox across exploded X-axis

lights.name: camera_fill
lights.role: broad low fill so graphite seals and dark body cavities do not die

lights.name: ball_core_highlight
lights.role: compact softbox reflection for polished ball readability

lights.name: left_axis_edge
lights.role: left X-axis parts and moved cover edge separation

lights.name: right_axis_edge
lights.role: right X-axis body shell, seats, and fastener array edge separation

lights.name: top_strip
lights.role: stem, bracket, and vertical stack readability

lights.name: hardware_low_edge
lights.role: small fastener and spring array glints without hard point-light blowout
